english: …Need something?
(What do you say at a time like this?)
Um, thank you for your service.
Wh—!
What are you saying? I was never\nimprisoned to begin with. I got out\nthrough a plea deal.
True, I was arrested once, but in exchange for\nproviding information and confessing…\nI was released right away…
Um, why do you look like you're about to cry?
D-don't be absurd! I would never—\nbe on the verge of tears from remembering…
(Something happened to her after the arrest…)
Were you, like, tortured…?
No, interrogated. At least, that's what\nthey insisted.
(What did they do to her…)
If you'd like, I'll listen.
…Interrogated.
Interrogated?
Yes, interrogated. According to them, anyway.\nFrom the receiving end, it's not much\ndifferent from torture…
'Them'?
…The people of Butei High.\nNothing but dangerous people.
You mean Aria-san and the others?
No. The students are still the better ones.\nI mean the faculty.
It's a school that raises Butei, so naturally\nthe faculty are Butei of great skill, too.
But whatever their skill, every last one of them\nis broken as a person…
Where they took me was a place called\nButei High's interrogation department.
There, a female teacher with a strange look in her eyes\nwas waiting, smoking something like a cigarette—\ncouldn't tell if it was legal or not.
There, I…
…Jehanne-san?
I-I can't go on…\nI went through something truly terrifying…
Jehanne-san?
(She's shaking like a leaf… For someone called\na witch to be this scared, what ARE\nButei High's teachers…)
(I'll be careful not to go near them.)
You again. What do you want this time?
Hm, could it be you want to join I-U, too?
But too bad. With your combat skills,\nthat's impossible.
(I haven't said anything yet…)
At least if you were an esper like Seika the shrine\nmaiden, it'd be a different story.
Isn't it the thing where you unwrap the bandages\non your right hand and sealed powers awaken?
Huh? Uh, no…
Thought so. If you had such powers, you'd be\nunder I-U's surveillance too.
With neither outstanding skill nor special ability,\nall I can say is give up.
(The mood won't let me say 'that's fine by me'…)
…It just occurred to me: why are you\ntagging along with this group?
Huh?
You're not particularly needed as a fighter.\nI'm asking why someone like you follows this lot.
Never thought about it.
Then why are you here?
Just how things turned out, I guess.
Because I want to be useful, maybe?\nI can at least help with housework.
Hm, a spirit of service.\nBy the way, why is that a question?
Because I don't really know myself.\nI just tagged along at first because\nthat's how things turned out.
How things turned out. You drifted along\nand ended up here, in other words.
Well, yeah.
I don't think this is something you can\ntag along with just because that's how things\nturned out…
Unknown enemies, repeated battles,\nimminent danger, life-or-death crises—\nnothing but that, I'd think.
I don't understand your thinking.
Don't scare me like that…\nWell, it's worked out so far,\nso I think it'll be fine from here on too. Probably.
No one knows what lies ahead.
No—Seika's shrine maiden, Shirayuki,\ncan supposedly do fortune-telling that sees\nthe future, I hear.
Why not get a reading?\nBefore you lose your life.
R-right… I'll ask her later.
Just be careful not to lose your life.
(After saying whatever she pleased,\nshe left me behind…)
(I was going to cheer her up about the other day,\nbut I guess she didn't need it.)
Hm…
Um, Jehanne-san?
Hm… can such a thing be allowed?
(She doesn't seem to hear me…\nWhat is she doing?)
Their feelings not reaching each other—absurd…
(Looks like she's reading manga.\nShoujo manga, apparently.)
Guh! So the two of them can never\nbe together…
Jehanne-san, is that manga?
Wh—! You…!
Do you like shoujo manga?
Huh? Y-yeah. Japanese romance manga are\nwonderful… I mean, that's not it!
(She's flustered for once.)
So this is your hobby.\nI didn't know.
I'm an unmarried maiden too… what's wrong\nwith liking shoujo manga?!
N-no, I didn't mean it like that…
More importantly, how long have you been watching!
Since a little while ago…
…is what I'm asking.
Huh?
You peeked at a maiden's secret…!
Eep!
Now that you know my secret, I can't let you live.\nI have no choice but to dispose of you here…!
…is what I'd like to say, but I am,\nfor better or worse, one of Butei High's people now.
(I'm saved…?)
I'll beat you just enough that you can't talk,\nand hand you over to the police.
Come to think of it, several people called you\na peeping tom…
I don't know how many prior offenses you have,\nbut expect no mercy!
(I was NOT saved!)
Hah!
That was close!
Ho, well dodged! But next time\nwon't go so well!
Eep!
Wh—! Wait!
What incredible speed…\nCan a human even move like that…?
So you haven't survived this long for nothing.\nThat evasion ability is quite something…
(That was close… So Jehanne-san was keeping\nher shoujo manga a secret. I'll keep quiet—\nif I don't, it'll be scary later…)
…You seem to be either a fool or a big shot—\none or the other.
Did you forget that I nearly cut you down\nthe other day?
That's why… I won't tell anyone, so\nplease let me off…
Is that true?
Y-yes!
Then that's fine.
(That was surprisingly easy…)
Well, I'll be going…
Um, why are you following me?
Observation.
Huh?
Don't make me repeat myself.\nI'm observing you.
The other day, not seriously or not,\nyou dodged my sword and fled at a speed\nI couldn't follow up on.
I've judged that evasion ability to be\nthe secret to your survival.
Few have escaped my sword.\nThat evasion ability is worth attention.\nSo I've made you my observation subject.
No, it's not something I can do\non purpose…
I see. Then I'll create a situation\nwhere you have no choice but to!
No way! I can't possibly match\nthe 'Silver-Ice Witch'…
Flattery won't make me hold back.
Wh-what are you going to do?!
This time, I'll use my powers too.
My true combat style is threefold: use strategy\nto whittle down their strength, seal their movement\nwith my powers, and then finish them.
I'll test just how far your evasion ability goes.
(I'd really rather not…)
Are you ready?
(Saying 'no' would be pointless, clearly…)
'La Pucelle's Shackles'!
Whoa! My feet are frozen, I can't move…!
Hah!
Guh!
…I thought you'd hold out a little longer,\nbut this is how it goes from the first move.\nWell, that's what happens when I'm serious.
Crushing the enemy's strengths and drawing them\ninto your advantage is the basics of strategy,\nbut I didn't expect it to end with that.
…Seems that was a wasted trip.
(Looks like she's exasperated.\n…That's fine, but I wish she wouldn't leave\nthe ice on my feet as-is.)
(Ugh… it's getting colder…)
Hah! No, this way is better.\nHmph! …Yes, this way is better after all.
Hm, maybe lower the sword tip a little more\nwould look better… No, not quite.
(What is she doing? Practice swings?)
Like this… yes, this is it.\nIntimidating, yet no openings.\nAnd above all, beautiful.
…Don't you think?
If you noticed, say something.\nSo, what were you doing?
It's obvious. Practicing my signature pose.
(So not practice swings…)
I got my hands on this big mirror…\napparently it's called a full-length mirror.
I was checking and fine-tuning\nmy signature pose's form.
Isn't that narci…
It's one way to draw out an advantage in battle.\nAbsolutely not.
(She didn't have to deny it so fast…)
For example, say you've cornered the enemy\nin a dead end. Walls surround them left, right,\nand behind; you stand before them.
Now suppose that in that situation, the enemy\ncalmly strikes a pose. What would you think?
I don't know.
…That was instant. You could think a little\nbefore answering.
The basics are to put yourself in that situation\nand think about what you'd do.
Like there's a trap set?
Not wrong, but vague.\nStill, not bad.
If it were me, I'd consider an ambush.
An ambush?
If another enemy blocked your back when you thought\nyou'd cornered them, you'd be caught in a pincer\nwith nowhere to run, right?
Then the situation reverses.\nYou'd be the one cornered.
In other words, you can make them think that\nand shake them up. That's what you call\na bluff.
I-I see…
Furthermore, appearance can have a psychological\neffect on the enemy regardless of the situation.
The prime example is weaponry.\nTanks, fighter jets, battleships.\nGuns and the like, too.
All weapons are designed to reassure allies\nand strike fear into the enemies facing them.
Some self-destruct under the pressure.\nThat happens in sports and gambling too,\nnot just combat, right?
So I am absolutely not a narcissist—\nI was merely training to gain the upper hand!
(That just looks like she's covering\nher embarrassment…)
Did you say something?
No, nothing.
(She's absorbed in manga again.)
Hah!
Eep!
Peeking again? Not an admirable hobby.
But it won't go like last time.\nI've trained to respond even while\nabsorbed in manga.
(Is that something to brag about?)
You'll never take me from behind again.\nToo bad for you.
With allies nearby, you don't have to\nbe so on edge…
I was letting my guard down, and it's your fault\nfor carelessly peeking.
S-sorry…
Don't disturb me. I'm at a good part.
Um…
Still here? Do you need something from me?
Could it be you wanted to read this manga?
Well, since you're offering.
I see. I'm reading volume 7, but you're free\nto read volumes 1 through 6.
Oh, and I've finished all of these manga,\nso read them as you like.
Is it interesting?
Depends on the reader's taste, but\nat least I find it interesting.
I just remembered—wasn't this a secret?
You already know about it.
Besides, the urge to share something\nI found interesting with others—\nI have that too.
According to Riko, that kind of behavior\nis called 'evangelizing.'
Hmph. For me, the 30th Joan of Arc,\nto evangelize—ironic, I find.
(That smile is scary…)
By the way, what's the one you're reading now about?
A love romance between a café clerk\nand a customer.
(I see. So she likes these kinds of stories.)
This uniform is cute…
Huh?
No, nothing…
(She doesn't just like manga—\nI wonder if she's interested in cute clothes too?)
(Sharing a secret like this… I feel like\nwe've gotten a lot closer…)
I want your opinion. What do you think\nof this?
This… the drawing? You mean?
Yes, a drawing I made.\nBy the way, why is that a question?\nYou can tell by looking.
(It looks like nothing but a child's scribble…\nActually, she's oblivious, isn't she…)
I want your opinion.\nTell me what you honestly think.
Of course, including the hard-to-say things.\nPersonally, I think I drew it rather well…
(For starters, I have no idea what it even is…\nFirst, figure out what she drew.)
Is this something you like, Jehanne-san?
Yes. I think it's fair to say so.
(Why is she embarrassed?)
Give me a hint!
What are you saying?\nNo hint needed—you can tell by looking.
(No good…)
So? Don't you think anything?\nIt doesn't reach the great artists, of course,\nbut it's quite good.
And don't you think it suits me?\n…Could your opinion differ?
('Suits me'? I still don't really get it, but\nsaying so seems like the safe move.)
Um… I think it suits you too.
R-right! I knew you'd think so.\nOnly natural.
My design sense for clothes aside,\nmost of all the model is good.
I'll give you this drawing as a memento.\nFeel free to make it a family heirloom.
Haah…
Fufu. I'm feeling motivated.\nLet's get started right away.
(In the end, what WAS that drawing?\nFrom what she said, it should be a person.)
(Silver hair and blue eyes… could it be\na self-portrait of Jehanne-san?)
(But it's neither armor nor a uniform. What clothes\nare those? Maybe she means they suit her?)
(She was acting strange, too.\nNormally she wouldn't be embarrassed\nto show a drawing…)
Huh? I came to see Jehanne-san, but\nwhere is this…?
Follow me. This way.
That voice—is that you, Jehanne-san?
Yes, I'm inside this classroom.
Th-this is…?
I prepared it for you.\nCome, entrust your body and soul to me.
Th-that outfit, could it be…
Yes… I made it based on that drawing\nyou saw.
…Does it suit me?
I-it really does!
I'm glad… I want you to look at me, only me.\nI prepared everything for you…
Wh-why go that far…
You praised my drawing the other day, didn't you?\nThose words melted my heart…
I want you to accept all of me…
Huh? Wh-what?!
What's wrong? Did you have a bad dream?
H-huh? Jehanne-san?\nYour usual outfit…
What are you talking about?\nI've dressed like this ever since\nI joined your group.
Personally, I hold that outfits\nthat bare too much leg are unbecoming\nof an unmarried maiden...
(So it was... a dream?)
That aside, there's something\nI'd like you to look at.
(A prophetic dream...!?)
What do you think of this painting?\nI'd like your opinion, same as last time.
...May I ask what it's called?
Hm. 'The Maid Outfit and I.'
I-I think it's wonderful...
(Just a dream after all, then...)
